O01: A job pins one ready immutable frame, account, destination and saved revision; invalid bindings cannot enqueue.
O02: Enqueue owns its input and is durable and idempotent for the same operation; conflicting intent and cross-workspace access fail.
O03: An attempt persists before sending; only a matching immutable acknowledgment ends uncertainty, including concurrent retries and restart.
O04: Current account/workspace and session authorization apply to reads and commit-time writes, including revocation during work.
O05: Failed local batches leave no partial intent/attempt/receipt; lost local acknowledgment responses recover the committed receipt.
O06: A populated v7 upgrades atomically without modifying prior migration checksums or stored data.
